latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of thesis abstract and keyword writing skill.

- Generates academically rigorous Abstract and Keywords sections for theses, dissertations, academic papers, and proposals in Chinese and/or English.
- Adapts output to thesis type (standard, structured, empirical, qualitative, literature review, scheme design) and user specifications (language, format, word limit).
- Requires reference to an included abstract/keyword writing guide to ensure quality, clarity, and consistency.
- Extracts all relevant information from user input and requests missing details if necessary.
- Provides only Abstract/摘要 and Keywords/关键词; explicitly avoids generating other thesis sections or inventing unsupported content.
